split.definition: Train/calibrate only ss_intf batch1 on disjoint hashed relationship/replicate groups; test batch2 of all models on the third disjoint group. Batch/model are excluded from group key. No random-row split.
split.independence_limit: Ped-sim documents independent founder replicates, but archive seeds/logs are absent. Random-stream independence across runs is not certified. Matching replicate IDs stay together conservatively.

excluded_anomalies.23138: Source reports zero total but positive segment count; unresolved rounding/zero-length anomaly. Retained in QC, not modeled or imputed.

limits: No unrelated, close non-cousin, half, removed, lineal, endogamy or genotyping-error hypotheses/controls.
No real genotypes or people; source is simulated IBD output, not raw DNA.
No detection threshold/sensitivity model for consumer DNA matching.
Scores assume a uniform limited class prior; not population or forensic posterior probabilities.
Conformal target relies on class-conditional exchangeability; crossover shift may violate it.
Positive-only methods have small distant-cousin training/calibration counts; report per-class outcomes.
Zero-sharing summaries restored from documented50000 slots and validated IDs, not treated as unrelated.
No hyperparameters tuned on test outcomes; no novelty claim.
